text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't change any tests. The fixes in `catalog/` were:

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`, which doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily rate to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns exactly `n`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. The tests and the comment above it both say 5, so I set it to 5.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing the third book. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The tests only check the title, so the author, year and copy count are my choice.
